compressor.merge_rule: syntactic hash-consing of identical (variable, low, high)
compressor.pruning: verified Horn or dual-Horn forward-chaining contradiction only

positive_result: An exact cross-language semantic interface can be compressed without a hidden SAT oracle by compiling tractable modules into proof-carrying ROBDDs and combining them with a charged apply operation.
negative_results: Any fixed-radius local extendability profile is incomplete: one Horn clause on r+1 variables collides with TRUE on every projection of size at most r.
ROBDD compression is exponentially order-sensitive even for equality 2-CNF.
A fixed exact OBDD target is not a universal polynomial interface language.
Trying multiple orders remains output-sensitive and all failed attempts are charged.

surviving_conjecture.name: Polynomial Proof-Carrying Interface Portfolio Conjecture
surviving_conjecture.statement: There exists one deterministic polynomial-time selector over a finite or polynomially generable portfolio of canonical interface languages such that every CNF module network can be compiled, composed, verified, and decoded with total polynomial representation and work.

distance_to_p_equals_np.what_improved: The project now has one explicit exact compressor whose merges require no semantic equivalence oracle and whose total construction work is charged.
distance_to_p_equals_np.remaining_target: Find a polynomially bounded mixed portfolio supporting conjunction and existential elimination for every CNF without conversion to an exponentially large universal format or hidden SAT queries.
